ValidationRule.description: Prevents MillTrack technicians from directly changing the Work Order, Maintenance Date, Maintenance Type and Labor Hours on an existing Maintenance Log.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.MillTrack_Technician_Restricted_Editing, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED( Work_Order__c ), ISCHANGED( Maintenance_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Maintenance_Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Labor_Hours__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Technicians cannot change the Work Order, Maintenance Date, Maintenance Type, or Labor Hours on an existing Maintenance Log. Use the approved service workflow instead.
